- Q4 reconciliation credit: $18,500 one-time
- Effective blended unit price delta: ~-4%

- Committed spend (year 1 equivalency): $610,000
- Blended discount: 11% off list rate (conditional on commit cadence)

- Blended discount: 14% off list rate
